outcome: accuracy of ultrasound measurement of SVC flow
cohort: 7 infants with a median postnatal age of 7 days (range 2-74 days), corrected gestation of 34.8 weeks (range 31.7-37.2 weeks) and weight of 1870 g (range 970-2660 g)
finding: Ultrasound assessment of SVC flow volume using the modifications described led to enhanced accuracy and decreased variability compared to prior techniques
